The price of a hammock generally ranges from $25 to $150, though premium all-in-one systems can exceed $300. Your final cost will depend heavily on whether you need a portable camping version, a permanent backyard setup, or a complete stand.

Entry-Level and Budget Options ($25 – $45)

These are typically simple parachute nylon or cotton hammocks. They are great for casual lounging in a park or backyard but often require you to purchase hanging straps separately.

  • Sunnydaze Decor Brazilian Double Hammock: A colorful, tightly woven cotton option designed for a "cocoon" feel. It is highly portable but does not include a stand or straps.
  • Bliss Hammocks with Pillow: Features hardwood spreader bars to keep the bed flat and wide, similar to a traditional bed.

Mid-Range Performance ($50 – $90)

In this range, you find reputable brands known for durability and lightweight materials. These are the standard for camping and backpacking.

  • ENO SingleNest Hammock: A reliable, compact choice for solo travelers made from breathable, quick-drying nylon.
  • ENO DoubleNest Hammock: One of the most popular models on the market, it fits two people and compresses to the size of a grapefruit for easy travel.
  • Kammok Roo Double Hammock: Known for its lunar lift fabric and high weight capacity (up to 500 lbs), it is a durable choice for frequent adventurers.

Hammock Sets with Stands ($90 – $150+)

If you don't have perfectly spaced trees, a bundle with a steel or wooden stand is the most convenient way to set up on a patio or deck.

  • Best Choice Products Double Hammock with Stand: A complete set featuring a Brazilian-style cotton hammock and a heavy-duty steel stand that supports up to 450 lbs.
  • Vivere Double Cotton Hammock with Stand: A popular all-in-one combo that is praised for tool-free assembly and a space-saving 9-foot stand.
